## Wyrm iOS 2.3.0 (135)

### ADDED
- Shed: a new page that makes fresh skins for you from a short recipe.
- 19 new arena backgrounds.
- Arena chat now has Team, Global and Online tabs.
- The folded chat button looks like your on-screen keys. Set its size, opacity, text and fill colour in Arrange arena UI.
- Global chat has its own name and message colours.
- New Boost choice in Modes: show the boost glow on your snake only, or on everyone's.
- Arrow Sensitivity (Controls â€º Customise arrow movement): 0% moves like the original slither, 100% moves the arrow furthest for a small finger move.
- Trails: a new camera and gallery, and a better editor.
- Trails feed tells you when new trails arrive and when you are all caught up.

### CHANGED
- Much smoother frame rate when the arena is full of long snakes.
- The game always runs at your screen's fastest refresh rate.
- Snake names are easy to read on every arena background.
- The boost glow is lighter.
- Photos in Trails, Share run and Share skin now use a proper cropper: the whole picture with a box you move, resize and zoom.
- Video trails are turned off for now.

### REMOVED
- Settings â€º Performance (no longer needed).
- The Boost strength slider.
- The Arrow lag slider (replaced by Sensitivity).

### FIXED
- The game no longer freezes while you touch the Rain panel.
- The Seafoam background no longer overflows its tile in the background picker.
